title: Study of Dapagliflozin on Mitochondrial Dysfunction and Impaired Insulin Signaling/Action
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to examine the effect of the chronic treatment of type 2 diabetes (T2DM) with dapagliflozin on: (1) mitochondrial gene function/expression and insulin signaling/action and (2) oral glucose tolerance and beta cell function. Dapagliflozin is a potent, highly specific inhibitor of renal glucose transport \[SGLT2\].
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* T2DM
* Drug Naive Or On Oral Therapy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Insulin Treatment
* Major Organ Disease
